reaction: The different jobs of the parts are clearer now.

reaction: The cutaway shows how the parts fit together.
reason: The remaining goal is to connect the eye to the body and its brain.

effect: The eyes are connected to the body and their nerves lead toward the brain, completing the chapter.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the retina and optic nerve was most worthwhile because it named the lining and showed how its signals leave the eye.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the finished eye to the body was straightforward and added less explanation than the earlier constructions.

surprise.text: I learned that the light-sensitive lining is called the retina and that its fibres gather into the optic nerve.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals made the pairings understandable.

continue.text: I would continue to see how another sense is built, though these combinations were mostly predictable.
